start_here: Say to your AI: "Run tool:plan-my-time with nothing more." Plan the person's tasks into their free time and judge their meetings against their pursuits, like an auto-scheduling calendar: ASAP first, then hard deadlines, then what serves their most important pursuit, then due date; tasks wait for their blockers, long tasks split into pieces, hard deadlines may use time outside working hours.
